title: No margin shows $0.00 and negative margins show a minus sign
refs: SV-11718 (Reports Story 1 S1-R13 Reports Story 4 S4-E1 TPX-30)
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 50.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 60.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier C, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is Markup % 0.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, put on tier B for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, put on tier C for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer B, with a part in category A, cost $10.00, priced $6.00 by tier B, invoiced today.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer C, with a part in category A, cost $100.00, priced $100.00 by tier C, invoiced today.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Pick customers B and C in the Customer filter.
  3. Click Download Summary (PDF) in the ⋯ menu.
  4. Click Download Summary (CSV) in the ⋯ menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier opens.

Step 2:

  • Tier C's row reads Parts Margin $0.00 ($100.00 − $100.00) and Parts Margin % 0.00%.
  • Tier B's row reads Parts Margin −$4.00 ($6.00 − $10.00) and Parts Margin % −66.67% (−$4.00 ÷ $6.00).
  • Totals read Parts Margin −$4.00 and Parts Margin % −3.77% (−$4.00 ÷ $106.00).
  • The negative percentages carry a minus sign in front.

Step 3:

  • The PDF shows −$4.00 and −66.67% for tier B and −$4.00 in the Totals.

Step 4:

  • The CSV shows -4.00 for tier B's Parts Margin and -4.00 in the Totals row.
  • The CSV numbers have no $ sign and use a plain minus.
